sourceAnalysis.transitionCounts: parseStateRow:412-438 requires nonempty normalized state, safe nonnegative integer count AND valid nonnegative minutes. buildStateAnalysis:440-546 uses first valid normalized state row, guarded sums, count shares, represented count and normalized entropy. Unknown nonempty state names remain visible.
sourceAnalysis.sleepDuration: analyzeSleepEfficiency:1005-1029 requires positive total dwell; asleep/total ratio is recomputed, reported percentage checked in [0,100], difference remains signed. Zero/missing time-to-sleep withheld without sample companion; no physical sleep claim.
sourceAnalysis.events: parseEventRow:566-632 requires timezone-suffixed parseable times, end >= start, no future against frozen mount clock, positive duration, safe nonnegative id, bounded SOC/loss, nonnegative rate and boolean Sentry. It does NOT reconcile timestamps/duration, SOC loss or dose/rate.
sourceAnalysis.accounting: Five state categories and six event categories are mutually exclusive by first matching validation reason. First valid id wins before newest-first sorting; directory caps 50 never affect all-valid-row summaries.
sourceAnalysis.availability: buildAvailability:853-948 has seven evidence gates; buildBreadth:950-972 awards 1 available / 0.5 partial and rounds to /100. This is source support, not confidence, coverage percentage or accuracy.
sourceAnalysis.sentry: buildSentryGroup:731-761 chooses first positive-count row per boolean mode. Metrics remain individually nullable; both count-bearing groups gate comparison even if all averages are missing.
sourceAnalysis.projection: buildSentryAnalysis:775-842 combines rate (% SOC/hour), capacity Wh / 1000 and 730 hours into local kWh, then price per kWh into currency. Positive capacity and nonnegative price are context, not measured energy. On-minus-off is clamped at zero, not a signed difference.
sourceAnalysis.immutability: Input arrays copied/derived and output recursively frozen at freezeDeep:974-981; no API cache payload rewriting.
sourceAnalysis.rawSI: Types explicitly document battery_capacity_wh in Wh and outside_temp/avg_temp in Celsius. Existing sleep duration fields are minutes/hours and rate fields lack explicit dimensional type comments; do not relabel them seconds or W without an authorized producer cutover.
sourceAnalysis.preferences: Capacity calls formatEnergy(Wh); event temperature calls formatTemperature(Celsius). Numeric formatters subscribe to preference changes. Local month projection still formats kWh directly, event times use browser defaults and currency symbol defaults can be unlabeled.
sourceAnalysis.measurementLimits: Summed event SOC losses are percentage-point totals, not total measured Wh; event-count Sentry share is not duration-weighted exposure; group rate difference is descriptive, not causal; valid-input checks cannot establish complete independent measured evidence.
